# Releases

Before preparing, tagging, publishing, or resuming **any release**, load and follow
[the prepare-release skill](./skills/prepare-release/SKILL.md). This is mandatory,
including when the request is simply "make a release."

Write the versioned, user-facing What's New help page before releasing. Do not tag
or publish until its version matches the app and release tag, its instructions match
the shipped features, and the bundled page opens from the main window's What's New button.
